title: 18074 - 18074/P1666
engines: Tüm VAG Benzinli (TSI/TFSI) ve Dizel (TDI) Motorlar
commonCauses: Kablo Tesisatı ve Soketleri and/or connections to/from the Valve for Pump Jet
stepByStepSolution: Kontrol edin:  wiring and Kontrol edin:  / Temizleyin:  all connections
Değiştirin / Yenileyin:  the cable-tree to/from all the Valfleri for Pump Jet
Değiştirin / Yenileyin:  Valve for Pump Jet (Değiştirin / Yenileyin: them all !)
technicalNotes: The ECU checks the Begin of Injection Period (BIP) by sending a very small amount of current (less than 0.0001 A ) through each injector. Because the current is so small, any extra resistance in the wiring due to damage or corrosion can cause this fault. Before replacing injectors, Değiştirin / Yenileyin: the wiring harness first.
